pli-tv-bu-vb-ss7:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Kosambiyaṃ viharati Ghositārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss7:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato Channassa upaṭṭhāko gahapati āyasmantaṃ Channaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss7:1.3: vihāravatthuṃ bhante jānāhi, ayyassa vihāraṃ kārāpessāmīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss7:1.4: atha kho āyasmā Channo vihāravatthuṃ sodhento aññataraṃ cetiyarukkhaṃ chedāpesi gāmapūjitaṃ nigamapūjitaṃ nagarapūjitaṃ janapadapūjitaṃ raṭṭhapūjitaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss7:1.6: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā cetiyarukkhaṃ chedāpessanti gāmapūjitaṃ . . . raṭṭhapūjitaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss7:1.8: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss7:1.9: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss7:1.10: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā Channo cetiyarukkhaṃ chedāpessati gāmapūjitaṃ . . . raṭṭhapūjitan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss7:1.11: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss7:1.12: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ Channa cetiyarukkhaṃ chedāpesi gāmapūjitaṃ . . . raṭṭhapūjitan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss7:1.15: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa cetiyarukkhaṃ chedāpessasi gāmapūjitaṃ . . . raṭṭhapūjitaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss7:1.17: n' etaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss7:1.18: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss7:1.19.1: mahallakaṃ pana bhikkhunā vihāraṃ kārayamānena sassāmikaṃ attuddesaṃ bhikkhū abhinetabbā vatthudesanāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss7:1.20: tehi bhikkhūhi vatthuṃ desetabbaṃ anārambhaṃ saparikkamanaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss7:1.21: sārambhe ce bhikkhu vatthusmiṃ aparikkamane mahallakaṃ vihāraṃ kāreyya bhikkhū vā anabhineyya vatthudesanāya, saṃghādiseso 'ti. ||1||
